record.field: Preventive CAPAs with a scope, a schedule of recurring checks and demonstrated effectiveness.

A preventive CAPA watches the products, locations and work centres in its scope. Every completed test on material in scope, or a fixed interval, raises a check with a named owner and a due date. A deviation is raised only when a check finds something.

A preventive CAPA can be verified only once at least one cycle has completed, and permanent controls are reviewed after closure.
